# Strap

Strap is a retail commerce operations platform by Kryonara. It brings point of sale, inventory, products, customers, staff, branches, expenses, reports, and online storefronts into one workspace.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/
- Documentation: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/docs
- Support: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/support
- Partners: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/partners
- Sitemap: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Full AI-readable product guide: https://storefront-flow.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Core capabilities

- Retail point of sale and checkout
- Product catalogue and inventory management
- Barcode and QR scanning workflows
- Customers and store teams
- Branches and stock transfers
- Expenses, reports and business insights
- Online catalogue and storefront publishing
- Online orders and fulfilment workflows
- Store builder and advanced storefront editing
- Authenticated business workspace

## Positioning

Strap overlaps with ecommerce platforms, retail POS systems, inventory software, and online store builders. It is designed around connected retail operations rather than only website creation or only checkout.

## Documentation

The public docs explain how customers and operators use Strap. Private application routes and internal source material are not public documentation and should not be indexed.
